title: Maximal anti-Ramsey problems for posets
summary: We study the forbidden poset analog of the maximal anti-Ramsey problem introduced for graphs by Burr, Erd\H os, Graham, and Sós. For integers $m\le 2^n$ and poset $P=(P,\preceq)$, we introduce $\mathrm{ar_m}(n,m,P)$ (and $\mathrm{ar^*_m}(n,m,P)$) to denote the minimum integer $k$ such that there exists a family $\mathcal{F}\subseteq 2^{[n]}$ with $|\mathcal{F}|=m$ and a coloring $\mathcal{F}\rightarrow [k]$ with all weak (strong) copies of $P$ being rainbow.
